title: Anticipated Avatar Fighting Game Delayed, But Only 3 Weeks
summary:
Cross-play beta to fill the time.

Just a quick heads-up if you were looking forward to the licensed fighting game Avatar Legends, which has quite a bit of buzz behind it: the game has been delayed, from 2nd July to 23rd July on the PS5.

Dev Gameplay Group said it’s “taking a little extra time to cook up an exceptional Avatar adventure, including brand new content previously unplanned”. Interesting.
